question: What status does will hold as scripture and command, supreme goddess?
premises: Will itself is identified as scriptural fulfillment.
This identification is declared as a command.
The declaration is addressed to the supreme goddess.
inference: Will is affirmed as both the attainment of scripture and authoritative command.
uncertainties: The repetition of ityājñā in the token list may reflect textual transmission issues.
plain_english: O supreme goddess, will itself is the fulfillment of scripture; thus is the command.
